quests.title: The Window Above Blacktown
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. 28 years above Blacktown. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. I do not hear the trains any more, which means I hear it instantly when one of them is wrong. Since grand final week the joins sound different. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: ride it and listen to the joins
photograph the stretch that sounds wrong
tell me I am not mad

quests.title: Setting Up at Jubilee Park
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. 17 years in the Jubilee Park market. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. The bays are not allocated, they are *known*, and since Thursdays somebody has decided that knowing does not count, and I have run out of ways to say it politely. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: the bays, at the hour it happens
the bloke with the extra trestle
you will want one at that hour
$28 of frontage, recovered

quests.title: The Clock at Wentworthville
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. Somebody set the Wentworthville clock that way on purpose and everyone who knows why is nearly gone. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. The old crew drink near Westmead on Thursdays. Go and ask, and nobody upstairs wants to hear it. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: the clock, four minutes fast, for the file
to Westmead, where the old crew drink
bring the name back

quests.title: The Dog at Meadowbank
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. Sits at the yellow line at Meadowbank at knock-off, waits, then walks off on its own. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. Half the platform knows and nobody has done anything, including me, and I am the only one who seems to have noticed. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: the end of the platform, at twenty to six
the collar, if it has got one
the street it walks home to
tell me it is not a sad story

quests.title: The Book at John Street Square
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. Up four hundred over eleven weeks on the John Street Square delay market. This is the third time I have had this conversation. You cannot beat a delay book unless you can see the roster, and they keep sending a different bloke. Think about who can see the roster. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: ride the run they ride
the two who follow you off it
$29 back off the book

quests.title: Last Service out of Leightonfield
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. Nothing runs out of Leightonfield after knock-off. It started small, the way these things do. I lock this end and the cleaner who does the whole line locks the other and in between there is a kilometre of lit platform for nobody. Ride the last one to Villawood and bring me a photograph of that. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: ride the late one to Villawood
the empty platform, lit and pointless
tell them what you saw

quests.title: The Domestic Airport Tap-Off
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. A card ending 23 boards at Domestic Airport on grand final week and vanishes. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Not a fare thing — ninety cents. I want to know *how*, and I am past being reasonable about it. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: ride the run the card rides
the gap in the fence everyone knows about
photograph it before somebody welds it

quests.title: The Bridge Street Order
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. I have made the same order for the same person every morning since I opened at Bridge Street. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Since the week of the show they have not turned up, and nobody upstairs wants to hear it. Go and knock. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: order one at the Bridge Street kiosk
the office they walk to, or used to
come back with $35 — I am not running a charity

quests.title: Four Minutes at Lewisham
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. Nobody upstairs believes me about Lewisham because I have 18 years and no data. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Go and stand on that platform on every second Friday and get me the data, and they keep sending a different bloke. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: stand under the board and wait like everyone else
photograph the board saying four minutes
ride the one that finally comes
give me the number

quests.title: Unclaimed at Jannali
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. Somebody lost something off the Jannali line on the first of the month and has not come for it, which never happens. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Find out why not. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: the address on the tag
the two who got there before you
$27 — whatever it is, it is worth that to somebody

quests.title: The Quiet Carriage, Carlton
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. Speakerphone. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. The first of the month, Carlton to town, speakerphone. I have made eye contact eleven times and it has achieved nothing. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: ride the quiet carriage and observe the crime
apply the shame manually
photograph the sign, for the record

quests.title: The Exhibition Centre Shortcut
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. Nine minutes between the shortcut at Exhibition Centre and the long way, and nine minutes is four drops. It started small, the way these things do. Since every second Friday there has been a padlock on it, and nobody will put it in writing. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: the end they lock
the long way round, so you understand what it costs
$35, which is what the long way costs me a week

quests.title: Possession at Penrith
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. Third time at Penrith on the week of the show. This is the third time I have had this conversation. Not kids — kids run. This one walks, and I am past being reasonable about it. I need it stopped before somebody writes a very long report about me. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: where they come through the fence
the ones who think a hard hat is a costume
photograph the gap so I can put a number on the form

quests.title: The Cowan Regular
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. Same stool since before I bought the place off Cowan road. This is the third time I have had this conversation. Gone since the week of the show, and it has been like that since the merge. I would like to know whether to keep the stool. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: the house they say he moved to
you cannot ask a favour empty-handed
come back and tell me straight

quests.title: Bay 14, Central Chalmers Street
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. People have started parking on the grass at Central Chalmers Street because of one abandoned car, and they keep sending a different bloke. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Photograph it, and the date on the ticket, so somebody can be embarrassed by it. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: the car, and the ticket, and the date on it
the two arguing over the grass
$32 in fines nobody is going to collect
